messages:
Lena V: Quick thread  Can we set recurring instructor office hours for new SIs during the first month after kickoff? Thinking 2x/week 1-hour slots. Need to confirm slots and who owns recordings.

Owen R: I can run Mon 10-11am PT and Thu 4-5pm PT. Would prefer not to record full sessions; keep TL;DR notes + anonymized Q&A log.

Chi N: Supports. Solutions can rotate a subject-matter lead each week: week1 infra, week2 marketplace, week3 cost optimization. That reduces single-person load.

Paula G: Marketplace asks: include a 10min demo in one office hour about voucher flows and badge wiring. Also we can publish a short FAQ after each session.

OnboardBot: onboard-bot: office-hour slot `Mon-10am-PT` created in calendar for 12 weeks (2026-05-04T17:00:00Z).

Lena V: Great. Owen, can you own the recurring calendar invites and the Q&A doc? I'll coordinate with marketplace for the demo slot and circulate a short template for Q&A notes.

Owen R: Yes, I'll create a shared doc and a template: "Question | Answer | Topic | Follow-up owner". Will DM leads to fill in.

Chi N: One operational note: ensure we tag session notes with partner org ids only if partners consent. Otherwise anonymize.

Paula G: Agreed. We'll add a consent checkbox to the sign-up form: share anonymized notes for product improvement? Y/N.

Lena V: Locking owners: Owen = calendar + notes, Paula = marketplace demo, Chi = rotating SMEs, Lena = partner comms + consent flow. Will publish schedule by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
